2608.18586.title: OmniHandwritingOCR: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal LLMs in Handwritten OCR Scenarios
2608.18586.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as OCR systems in document and knowledge-processing pipelines, but their ability to faithfully read real handwriting remains underexplored. Existing OCR benchmarks focus largely on printed text or clean single-line inputs, leaving limited coverage of realistic handwritten OCR scenarios such as multilingual handwriting, writer errors, and structurally complex mathematical expressions. We introduce OmniHandwritingOCR, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs and OCR systems on handwritten OCR. It covers handwritten text recognition and handwritten mathematical expression recognition across six subtasks and twelve subsets, totaling 77.57K labeled images from public datasets and newly collected student writings. A key component is a difficulty-stratified multi-line formula corpus designed to test robustness under increasing structural complexity. We evaluate thirteen open- and closed-source systems with five complementary metrics under a unified protocol. Results show that current systems remain far from faithful transcription: performance drops sharply on complex multi-line formulas, model rankings vary across language and formula settings, and several generative models hallucinate plausible but visually unsupported corrections. OmniHandwritingOCR provides a challenging testbed for diagnosing language, content, structural, and visual-grounding failure modes of multimodal models in handwritten OCR scenarios.
2608.18586.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在文檔和知識處理管道中越來越多地用作光學字符識別（OCR）系統，但它們忠實閱讀真實手寫文字的能力仍然未被充分探索。現有的OCR基準主要集中在印刷文本或乾淨的單行輸入上，對於現實手寫OCR場景的覆蓋範圍有限，例如多語言手寫、書寫者錯誤和結構複雜的數學表達式。我們介紹了OmniHandwritingOCR，一個用於評估MLLMs和OCR系統在手寫OCR方面的診斷基準。它涵蓋了手寫文本識別和手寫數學表達式識別，分為六個子任務和十二個子集，總計77.57K標記圖像來自公共數據集和新收集的學生寫作。其關鍵組件是一個難度分層的多行公式語料庫，旨在測試在結構複雜性增加下的穩健性。我們在統一協議下使用五個互補指標評估了十三個開源和閉源系統。結果顯示，當前系統距離忠實轉錄仍然相去甚遠：在複雜的多行公式上性能急劇下降，模型排名在不同語言和公式設置中變化，並且幾個生成模型會幻覺出看似合理但視覺上不支持的修正。OmniHandwritingOCR為診斷多模態模型在手寫OCR場景中的語言、內容、結構和視覺基礎失效模式提供了一個具有挑戰性的測試平台。
